verdict.rationale: Turso documents a Platform API for programmatically managing databases, groups, organizations and tokens, including creating, token-scoping and tearing down databases. Its MCP integration also covers account management, which shows broad programmatic control of core resources. However, no evidence states that the API matches everything the dashboard UI can do, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of UI-only functions such as billing, members/invites and settings, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Programmatically manage databases, groups, organizations, and tokens with the Turso Platform API.
Each entity gets its own isolated SQLite database that you create, token-scope, and tear down via the API.
Connect any MCP-capable AI agent and it can manage your Turso Cloud account — organizations, databases, groups — and run SQL, on your behalf.
